fields.Name: IT124 - Agent Consult
fields.Description: Deterministic sub-agent consult, escalation, request persistence, and entity-driven resume end to end with no live model call: IT: Consult Parent (DriverClass=ITConsultParentAgent, ChatHandlingOption=Consult) invokes IT: Consult Child (DriverClass=ITConsultChildAgent), which returns a Chat question; the parent escalates with its own Chat step, leaving the parent run AwaitingFeedback with one Requested MJ: AI Agent Requests row; answering the request triggers MJAIAgentRequestEntityServer.resumeAgent, which reloads the open consult from the parent's persisted Sub-Agent step, injects the sub-agent-consult message before the user answer, and lets the parent resume the child via resumeRunId so the child receives assistant:<question> then user:<answer> and both runs complete.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Parent pauses AwaitingFeedback with one Requested row; responding triggers resumeAgent, reloads open consults, resumes child with assistant:<question> and user:<answer>, and completes both runs with zero live LLM calls.
